mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT50010.retrieveAttendanceClose*/ TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'YYYYMM'), 'MM/YYYY') as time_and_attendance_yyyymm ,TO_CHAR(period_from_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') as period_from_date ,TO_CHAR(period_to_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') as period_to_date ,perfect_attendance_days ,TO_CHAR(unpaid_period_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') as unpaid_period_date ,TO_CHAR(unpaid_apply_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') as unpaid_apply_date ,TO_CHAR(period_close_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy HH24:MI') as period_close_date ,confirm_flag FROM TB_ATT_CLOSE_N WHERE subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} -- Session Parameter로 셋팅 AND time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}
mapper.update: /*LGVATT50010.insertAttendanceClose*/ MERGE INTO TB_ATT_CLOSE_N a USING ( SELECT #{subsidiaryCode} AS subsidiary_code , #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm} AS time_and_attendance_yyyymm , TO_DATE(#{periodFromDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_from_date , TO_DATE(#{periodToDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_to_date , TO_DATE(#{periodCloseDate},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS period_close_date , #{perfectAttendanceDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS perfect_attendance_days , #{confirmFlag} AS confirm_flag , TO_DATE(#{unpaidPeriodDate},'DD/MM/YYYY') AS unpaid_period_date , TO_DATE(#{unpaidApplyDate},'DD/MM/YYYY') AS unpaid_apply_date , #{applicationUserId} AS user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET period_from_date = b.period_from_date , period_to_date = b.period_to_date , period_close_date = b.period_close_date , perfect_attendance_days = b.perfect_attendance_days , confirm_flag = b.confirm_flag , unpaid_period_date = b.unpaid_period_date , unpaid_apply_date = b.unpaid_apply_date , last_update_user_id = b.user_id , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(subsidiary_code,time_and_attendance_yyyymm,period_from_date,period_to_date,period_close_date,perfect_attendance_days,confirm_flag,unpaid_period_date, unpaid_apply_date,creation_user_id,creation_date,last_update_user_id,last_update_date) VALUES(b.subsidiary_code,b.time_and_attendance_yyyymm,b.period_from_date,b.period_to_date,b.period_close_date,b.perfect_attendance_days,b.confirm_flag,b.unpaid_period_date, b.unpaid_apply_date,b.user_id,SYSDATE,b.user_id,SYSDATE)
